name: coupled_particle_catalysis
description: One cell, two coupled sub-cellular sims: a Smoldyn particle population (A+B→C, confined to the cell polygon) catalyses an SBML-ODE reaction S→P — the live particle C count sets the ODE rate constant each step (mode B), so P accumulates faster as the particle population builds. Runs a small tissue of these coupled cells.

n_cells.description: number of coupled cells in the tissue

config.scene: Scene(cells={'c0': CellSpec(type='coupled_cell', position=[6.0, 6.0], molecule_levels={}), 'c1': CellSpec(type='coupled_cell', position=[18.0, 6.0], molecule_levels={}), 'c2': CellSpec(type='coupled_cell', position=[6.0, 18.0], molecule_levels={})}, domain={'extent_um': [36.0, 36.0]})

scene_model.doc:
One orchestrating process for a whole scene.

Holds the tissue mechanics backend + one :class:`IntracellularAdapter` per cell
(by ``ModelSpec.formalism``) + one shared :class:`FieldExtracellular`. Each
``update()`` advances the mechanics, reads every cell's footprint/position, steps
each adapter (particle cells get their polygon), and routes any crossed molecules
into the field via the membrane contract.

Config carries live Python objects (scene/registry/field) opaquely via the
``quote`` schema — the document is built by :func:`compile_scene`, never
round-tripped through JSON.

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type
